title: Benchmark SOL on Tiny Shakespeare with recurrent controls
description: Add checkpoint/resume and train/validation evaluation for a real character corpus. Compare persistent state, shuffled/reset-state ablations, fixed-edge null policies, and a parameter-matched GRU baseline. Report held-out loss, generation samples, cell/edge credit, energy, and reachability.
notes: S0 controls complete: no-metabolism best/final 2.451/2.535; lr1e3 2.523/2.559; no-reward 2.492/2.624; default reward best/final 2.484/2.562. Current cell reward yields only 0.008 best-BPC benefit and worse final stability. Fast-memory experiments active on both GPUs.
close_reason: Completed matched Tiny Shakespeare benchmark, recurrent/transformer controls, fixed-edge, no-metabolism, lower-LR, no-reward, state ablations, topology, warmup sweep, guarded report, checkpoint promotion, and local live bridge.

title: Add reward-modulated fast synaptic memory to SOL
description: After the S0 reward ablation completes, extend FieldState with bounded per-edge eligibility and fast plasticity. Local pre/post activity should tag directed dendrites; delayed scalar reward should change only tagged fast synaptic efficacy across truncation boundaries while exact BPTT remains the slow weight learner. Checkpoint/resume must preserve the state. Tests must prove delayed specificity, no-reward invariance, boundedness, gradient flow, and no energy minting. This is a prerequisite for credit-driven axon growth rather than random rewiring.
notes: Full-scale seed7 is statistically unresolved: fast best 2.4392529 versus matched no-fast 2.4418460 (0.0025931 BPC, about 0.1%, best-of-20 on 2048 scored chars), while fast final is 0.0168705 BPC worse. Best-checkpoint zero-fast penalty is +0.0027449, showing small causal use but not a replicated net capability gain. Seed13 full pair launched on 4090/2070S as PIDs 1459378/1459379; seed21 will follow. Do not declare S1 passed from seed7 alone.
close_reason: Closed as a stable but capability-neutral negative result: the full-scale fast best beat matched no-fast by only 0.00259 BPC (about 0.1%, best-of-20), finished 0.01687 BPC worse, and did not justify more replication.

title: Make SOL energy govern viability and distributed metabolism
description: Extend sol/ so externally earned energy propagates through the directed connectome, pays cell and axon costs, gates computation, and can cause reversible quiescence or death. Add conservation/provenance tests so recurrent self-excitation cannot mint stimulation or energy.

close_reason: Removed the repository's OpenAI Sites project binding and deployment packaging; updated documentation for localhost-only use; lint, build, rendered UI tests, endpoint tests, and localhost HTTP check all pass. title: Build SOL continuous character-field prototype
description: Create sol/ as an independent experimental package for a persistent character-level neural field. The prototype must use sparse directed axon/dendrite communication rather than convolutional neighborhoods, preserve state across streamed characters, train with continuous truncated BPTT, expose delayed-credit/eligibility memory, model energy from novel stimulation, and demonstrate next-character learning with tests and companion documentation.
notes: Implemented sol/ fixed sparse directed axon field, persistent FieldState, continuous corpus lanes, truncated BPTT, retained cell/edge credit diagnostics, eligibility-gated delayed reward, stimulation-dependent energy, CLI generation, and modular companion docs. Verification: sol tests 7/7; full repo 17/17; 120-update CPU smoke loss 3.5735 -> 0.6646, perplexity 35.64 -> 1.94 with nonzero cell and edge credit. Follow-ups: DMON-1-ji4 metabolism/viability, DMON-1-uei axon growth/pruning, DMON-1-bqb Tiny Shakespeare controls.
close_reason: Fixed-topology continuous character organism implemented, documented, and verified end to end.

title: Grow and prune SOL axons from local activity and credit
description: After fixed-topology transport is stable, add structural phases between differentiable windows. Targets should accumulate candidate source IDs from measured causal traffic, grow bounded directed dendrites when endpoints can pay, and prune old low-credit edges. Preserve optimizer and persistent-state integrity across topology changes.
notes: Structural implementation ready for GPU. Targets receive round-robin non-edge probes measured by with/without-probe GRU counterfactual; signed delayed reward retains incumbent/candidate credit. Only positive candidates clearing 0.001 advantage may replace one mature slot; full reachability, endpoint payment, and optimizer/state integrity guarded. Probes-only control has identical exploratory traffic/rotation and ordinary learning, no permanent mutation. Zero-weight graft was harmful; probe-equivalent graft preserves causal traffic. Final 16x16 CPU smoke: growing 8 rewires, 4.308 BPC, birth-topology ablation 4.394 (+0.086), full reachability; probes-only 0 rewires, 4.300. Mechanism causal, overall capability tied. Full suite 38 tests before push/GPU.
